reviewItem.question: For "Removal of wildcard roles: Prior versions of Kyverno included wildcard view permissions", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the environment has mutate or generate policies, or validation rules, that target custom resources, and whether the unnamed Helm upgrade option from the upgrade guide is set

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removes its wildcard view RBAC permissions and replaces them with a role binding to the system view role. This may affect mutate and generate policies for custom resources, and policy-result reporting for validation rules on custom resources.
